sloka: अनिद्रः सततं रामः सुप्तो ऽपि च नरोत्तमः ।सीतेति मधुरां वाणीं व्याहरन् प्रतिबुद्ध्यते ।। ५.३६.४४।।।।
transliteration: anidraḥ satataṁ rāmaḥ supto 'pi ca narottamaḥ ।sīteti madhurāṁ vāṇīṁ vyāharan pratibuddhyate ।। 5.36.44।।।।

translations.english: "Rama, the best of men never goes to sleep and even if he drops off to sleep he mutters 'Sita, Sita' in a sweet voice in his sleep.
